title: Chapter 1: Why Cloud Databases Changed Everything

questions.q: According to the chapter, which of the following remains entirely the cloud DBA's responsibility on managed services?
options: Schema design, index strategy, and query optimization
questions.explain: The chapter states managed services do not manage schema design, index strategy, query plans, connection pool sizing, or data lifecycle policies — these remain entirely your responsibility.

questions.q: How are automated backups implemented on RDS for SQL Server?
options: Storage-level snapshots combined with continuous transaction log uploads to S3
The DBA runs BACKUP DATABASE on a schedule via SQL Server Agent
Transaction log shipping to a standby instance
Weekly full backups stored on the instance's local disks
questions.explain: The chapter explains that on RDS for SQL Server, automated backups combine storage-level snapshots with continuous transaction log uploads to S3; you do not run BACKUP DATABASE manually.

questions.q: RDS IAM database authentication tokens are valid for:
questions.explain: The chapter states the IAM authentication token is generated on the fly with a 15-minute validity window, so tokens must be generated fresh per connection.

questions.q: In the RDS parameter group example, max server memory is set to {DBInstanceClassMemory/1048576}*3/4. What is the advantage of this formula syntax?
options: It disables max server memory entirely
It hard-codes the value so it survives instance resizes
It is required for SQL Server Agent to function
It resolves against the actual memory of the instance class, keeping the parameter group portable across instance sizes
questions.explain: RDS resolves the formula against whatever instance class the parameter group is applied to, so the group stays portable across instance sizes without manual recalculation.

questions.q: AWS states that a standard RDS Multi-AZ failover typically completes within:
questions.explain: The chapter notes AWS states Multi-AZ failover typically completes within one to two minutes for standard RDS, and the application must handle reconnection across that window.
